purpose: Server-rendered asset management dashboard for existing assets and new uploads.
businessRules: Existing assets and categories must be fetched from SHRESTA-BE before rendering.
The page should remain readable on mobile and desktop with grouped search, upload, bulk assignment, and asset-card sections.
Visible admin copy should say catalog details/details instead of casual metadata jargon where the exact database field name is not required.

Upload and edit forms must include the editable DB-backed metadata fields exposed by backend contracts, including categoryFamilyKey, categoryProductTypeKey, productSku, tags, alt text, and SEO fields.
SKU selectors must be populated from backend-owned product records rather than asset metadata guesses.

Tag selectors must be populated from backend-owned storefront, category, and asset data rather than frontend constants, then normalized to uppercase enum-safe values with the shared 40-character/16-tag asset contract.
Images shown in admin use backend S3/CDN URLs, LQIP, versioned URLs, and generated variant metadata.
Existing assets expose a replace-image form that submits a single image to SHRESTA-BE and keeps the asset key stable.
Brand/system chrome such as the SHRESTA logo is not part of the admin asset manager; the backend asset API only returns catalog-managed media.
Image load failures are reported here so administrators can replace/re-upload assets; customer pages should use silent SHRESTA fallbacks.
Archive/remove hides records through backend APIs; frontend must not locally delete state as truth.
Backend network failures and backend API 404 responses render AdminApiUnavailable instead of the Next runtime overlay.
